name: Marcus Chen
headline: Senior AI/ML Engineer
summary: Senior AI/ML Engineer with 8 years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems, specializing in deep learning architectures and LLM-powered applications. Proven track record of leading model development from research to production, with expertise in PyTorch-based training pipelines and LangChain-driven generative AI solutions.

responsibilities: Lead development of retrieval-augmented generation systems using LangChain and vector databases
Design and train custom transformer models for NLP tasks using PyTorch
Mentor junior engineers on ML best practices and model deployment strategies
Collaborate with product teams to translate business requirements into ML solutions
Optimize inference pipelines to reduce latency for production LLM applications
Built and maintained computer vision models for automated quality inspection systems
Developed data preprocessing pipelines for large-scale image datasets
Implemented model monitoring and retraining workflows using MLflow
Collaborated with data engineering team to improve feature store infrastructure
Developed predictive models for customer churn and demand forecasting
Performed exploratory data analysis and feature engineering on structured datasets
Built dashboards and reports to communicate model insights to stakeholders
